summary: The comment opposes limiting or sunsetting E-Rate funding, citing the need to maintain current library services and the cost implications of losing this revenue source.

claims.argument: Any loss of funding will need to be made up from somewhere
claims.evidence_quote: Our member libraries rely on e-rate so they don't have to pay elevated fees for services from the SAILS library network. Any loss of funding will need to be made up from somewhere.
